integrity: All finite-state counts independently enumerated; algebraic proof is separate from finite computation. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Even-order projective planes and their nonincidence graphs; no sharp clock for arbitrary order, and the finite census pertains only to order two. Unindexed equivalent historical claims cannot be excluded.
title: Critical-threshold spectral extinction on projective nonincidence graphs and a sharp Fano census
